messages:
Sam (PM): Proposal: 'Degradation Grace Credits' (DGC). Purpose: let customers pre-purchase budget that triggers controlled degradations (cheaper model / skip optional transforms) during capacity pressure so apps stay responsive. Want quick feedback on launch criteria and contract language.

Theo (Eng): From infra POV we can implement a lightweight gating hook in the routing layer: check credit balance -> set request tag -> route to degraded pool. Key: O(1) check and minimal added latency.

Jules (DevEx): Console UX: grant credits at route-level, set auto-apply rules (latency threshold, error rate, manual toggle), preview estimated savings. Need event stream for when degradations occurred.

Marco (Sales): Customers will love being able to avoid 500s. Call it "grace budget" in sales pitches. Pilot offer idea: 1k free credits for early adopters and discounted top-ups.

Tess (Finance): Quick margin note: if degraded models cost 30% of baseline, credits should reflect that delta. We'll need mapping: 1 credit = X request handled by fallback. Recommend conservative pricing to start.

Priya (Legal): Don't promise specific latency SLOs. Suggested clause: "DGCs provide prioritized, budgeted degradation behavior; availability depends on system capacity and may be best-effort unless explicitly reserved." Add pilot rollback and data-retention permissions.

Sam (PM): Proposed pilot scope: 2 customers, 1 route each, support model-fallback + feature-flag fallback, dashboard visibility, and billing telemetry. Launch criteria: <8% platform cost increase at 99th percentile, no more than 5 customer-visible regressions, positive pilot CSAT.

Theo (Eng): Estimate: spec + small infra changes ~1 sprint; routing + metrics + tests ~1-2 sprints. If we reuse model pools it's faster. Need a safety mode to auto-disable DGC if fallback pool crosses pressure threshold.

Jules (DevEx): UI fields: route selector, credit budget (units), trigger rules (latency|error|manual), auto-topup threshold. Mock in Figma by Wed. Also need a read-only pilot toggle in the Console.

Marco (Sales): Pilot targets: two mid-market customers with bursty batch jobs. Will craft pitch: predictable bill + fewer production incidents.

Tess (Finance): Draft SKU idea: DGC-1000 (1000 credits) $149/mo, DGC-5K (5000 credits) $649/mo, PAYG $0.18/credit. Floating until we validate cost mapping.

Sam (PM): Example SKU json for notes:

```
sku_id: DGC-1000
name: "Degradation Grace Credits - 1k"
units: credits
bundle: 1000
price_usd: 149
validity_days: 30
notes: "applies at route-level; best-effort fallback unless reserved"
```

Priya (Legal): Also require customers to acknowledge degraded-observability (some telemetry may be reduced during fallback) and to opt-in for traffic steering. Pilot T&Cs should include clear refund/credit policy.

Theo (Eng): Ops request: simulate a 3-minute, 5x spike with 40% of requests eligible for downgrade. @ops-bot can you queue a sim and post resource impact & estimated credit burn?

ops-bot: Simulation queued: job #9001 "DGC pilot 3min 5x spike". ETA 2h. Will return CPU/GPU usage, fallback pool pressure, and credit burn.

Sam (PM): Next steps: Theo -> tech spec + safety-mode design; Jules -> console mock; Priya -> pilot T&Cs; Marco -> shortlist pilot customers; Tess -> refine SKU margins. I'll assemble PRD draft Friday. Thanks all :thumbsup:
